snippet.title: Disney Illusion Island Starring Mickey And Friends Trailer - NOW AVAILABLE ON ALL PLATFORMS!
snippet.description:
We're excited to announce that "Disney Illusion Island starring Mickey and Friends" is coming to PS5, Xbox Series S/X, Windows Store, Steam and GOG.

Launching May 30 2025, featuring the brand-new "Cave Adventuring Scavenger Hunt" update, on all platforms including Nintendo Switch!
